data.narrative:
Valthos, a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Kathleen McMahon and Tess van Stekelenburg, has raised $30M to date. Valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of 10 firms (2 public, 8 private) including same-sector peers UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic at similar or adjacent stages.

Two methods anchor the analysis. Stage-Progression applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $75M. Peer-Median references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $400M (range: $125M–$1.0B), directly implying $400M.

The triangulated valuation range is $64M–$460M, with a median of $238M. The substantial spread reflects the dual drivers: Valthos's relative youth and modest capital base (supporting lower-end scenarios) versus the high valuations achieved by peer firms in a well-capitalized defense-tech sector (supporting higher-end scenarios). Key uncertainties include product-market fit validation, customer traction in regulated defense procurement channels, and whether Valthos's technology and team merit peer-level multiples. Resolution of these operational and commercial milestones will be critical to narrowing the range as the company progresses toward Series A.
